name: William Lawrence Camp
description_short: A traditional, not-for-profit overnight camp for boys entering grades 3–11 in New Hampshire's Lakes Region, founded in 1913. The camp is device-free, cabins have no electricity, and activities are nature-based and outdoors.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp lists daily swim lessons. Waterfront activities include swimming, sailing and paddling.
